Ratio.Name: Coin ratio
Ratio.Hint: How classic gold/silver/copper is converted into item prices. Applied the next time you build the loot pools.
Ratio.Ten: Standard 5e (10:1, converted by value; small amounts lose precision)

Convert.Name: Convert items to 5e when building
Convert.Hint: When on, Build also converts every copied item to dnd5e rules into the Loot Ledger · Converted Items compendium and points the roll tables at the converted versions. Lines the converter has no rule for are listed for GM review in the Loot Ledger · Build Report journal instead of being invented. Applied the next time you build.

Tooltip.Name: Item tooltip (hold Shift)
Tooltip.Hint: Off by default. While on, hold Shift and hover an item on a sheet, in the Items sidebar, a compendium or a chat card to see a tooltip with its rarity colour, stats, price, weight and a comparison with your character's equipped item in the same slot. Only affects you.

Menu.Name: Loot pools
Menu.Title: Loot Ledger
Menu.Hint: Copy every classic MMO item into a world compendium with sell-accurate prices and generate rollable loot tables.
Menu.Intro: Builds world compendiums from the source item module: a priced copy of every item, optionally a 5e conversion of every item, and roll tables by quality, item type, mixed drop and creature type. Re-running updates only what changed; nothing else in the world is touched apart from the Build Report journal.
